import json, os, subprocess
item = _items[0]["json"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
with open(os.path.join(root, "script.json")) as fh:
    script = json.load(fh)
fps = int(script.get("fps", 25))
chars = {c["id"]: c for c in script.get("characters", [])}
motion_cycle = ["zoom_in", "zoom_out", "pan_left", "pan_right"]
plan_shots = []
k = 0
for scene in script.get("scenes", []):
    for shot in scene.get("shots", []):
        sid = shot["id"]
        png = os.path.join(root, "shots", sid + ".png")
        aud = os.path.join(root, "audio", sid + ".mp3")
        if not os.path.exists(png):
            raise RuntimeError("missing " + png + " — run the Shot Images stage first")
        if not os.path.exists(aud):
            raise RuntimeError("missing " + aud + " — run the Voiceover stage first")
        pr = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration", "-of", "csv=p=0", aud],
                            capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
        dur = float(pr.stdout.strip())
        m = shot.get("motion")
        if m not in motion_cycle:
            m = motion_cycle[k % 4]
        if shot.get("narration"):
            sub = shot["narration"].strip()
        else:
            sub = "\n".join(
                (chars.get(d.get("character", ""), {}).get("name") or d.get("character") or "?") + ": " + d.get("text", "")
                for d in shot.get("dialogue") or []
            )
        plan_shots.append({"id": sid, "dur": round(dur, 3), "frames": max(2, round(dur * fps)), "motion": m, "subtext": sub})
        k += 1
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "slug": slug, "fps": fps, "burn_subs": bool(item.get("burn_subs")),
                  "font_size": item.get("font_size", 24), "music_file": item.get("music_file") or "",
                  "music_volume": item.get("music_volume", 0.15), "shots": plan_shots}}]

import json, os, subprocess
plan = _items[0]["json"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + plan["slug"]
fps = int(plan["fps"])
os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, "render"), exist_ok=True)
zoom_expr = {
    "zoom_in": "min(1.0+0.10*on/{F},1.10)",
    "zoom_out": "max(1.10-0.10*on/{F},1.0)",
    "pan_left": "1.08",
    "pan_right": "1.08",
}
rendered = []
for shot in plan["shots"]:
    sid = shot["id"]
    F = int(shot["frames"])
    z = zoom_expr[shot["motion"]].replace("{F}", str(F))
    if shot["motion"] in ("zoom_in", "zoom_out"):
        x = "iw/2-(iw/zoom/2)"
        y = "ih/2-(ih/zoom/2)"
    elif shot["motion"] == "pan_left":
        x = "(iw-iw/zoom)*on/" + str(F)
        y = "(ih-ih/zoom)/2"
    else:
        x = "(iw-iw/zoom)*(1-on/" + str(F) + ")"
        y = "(ih-ih/zoom)/2"
    vf = ("[0:v]scale=1920:1080:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=1920:1080,scale=3840:2160,"
          "zoompan=z='" + z + "':x='" + x + "':y='" + y + "':d=" + str(F) + ":s=1920x1080:fps=" + str(fps) + ",format=yuv420p[v]")
    outp = os.path.join(root, "render", sid + ".mp4")
    cmd = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error",
           "-i", os.path.join(root, "shots", sid + ".png"),
           "-i", os.path.join(root, "audio", sid + ".mp3"),
           "-filter_complex", vf,
           "-map", "[v]", "-map", "1:a",
           "-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "veryfast", "-crf", "18", "-pix_fmt", "yuv420p",
           "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k",
           "-shortest", "-t", "%.3f" % shot["dur"],
           outp]
    subprocess.run(cmd, check=True)
    rendered.append(sid)
plan["ok"] = True
plan["clips"] = len(rendered)
return [{"json": plan}]

import base64, datetime, json, os, subprocess
item = _items[0]["json"]
plan = item["plan"]
slug = item["slug"]
root = "/home/node/files/films/" + slug
with open(os.path.join(root, "subs.srt"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    fh.write(item["srt"])
concat = os.path.join(root, "render", "concat.mp4")
film = os.path.join(root, "film.mp4")
vf = "[0:v]format=yuv420p[v]"
if plan.get("burn_subs"):
    style = "FontSize=%d,Outline=1,Shadow=0,MarginV=28" % int(plan.get("font_size") or 24)
    vf = "[0:v]subtitles=" + os.path.join(root, "subs.srt") + ":force_style='" + style + "',format=yuv420p[v]"
args = ["ffmpeg", "-y", "-loglevel", "error", "-i", concat]
music = (plan.get("music_file") or "").strip()
if music:
    mp = music if os.path.isabs(music) else os.path.join(root, "music", os.path.basename(music))
    if not os.path.exists(mp):
        raise RuntimeError("music file not found: " + mp)
    args += ["-stream_loop", "-1", "-i", mp]
    vol = plan.get("music_volume", 0.15)
    fc = vf + ";[1:a]volume=" + str(vol) + "[m];[0:a][m]amix=inputs=2:duration=first:dropout_transition=0[a]"
    args += ["-filter_complex", fc, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]"]
else:
    args += ["-filter_complex", vf, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "0:a"]
args += ["-c:v", "libx264", "-preset", "medium", "-crf", "18",
         "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", "192k", "-movflags", "+faststart", film]
subprocess.run(args, check=True)
pr = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration,size", "-of", "json", film],
                    capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
meta = json.loads(pr.stdout)
now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().isoformat() + "Z"
pf = os.path.join(root, "project.json")
proj = json.load(open(pf)) if os.path.exists(pf) else {}
proj.update({"status": "rendered", "updated_at": now})
proj.setdefault("stages", {})["assembly"] = {"status": "done", "done_at": now}
with open(pf, "w") as fh:
    json.dump(proj, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
return [{"json": {"ok": True, "film": film, "duration": round(float(meta["format"]["duration"]), 2),
                  "size_mb": round(int(meta["format"]["size"]) / 1048576, 2)}}]
